deployment_kinds.virtual: exists only in simulation: a robot description and a simulator play the hardware (the system-ID oracle's examples)

families.kinematics: where the parts are: frames, link geometry, joint zeros, transmission ratios, with no force in it
families.dynamics: how it moves under commands and loads: inertia, friction, compliance, backlash, the drive, heat
families.measurement: how a sensor turns the world into readings: quantisation, noise, latency, projection, depth, spectral response

excitations.driven: a command moved it for the whole run (position, velocity or current targets)
excitations.free response: no command acted: it moved (or cooled) on its own, so its data does not depend on the controller
excitations.mixed: a driven segment, then a free one: a swing released to coast; a heating run, then its cool-down with the bridge off
excitations.unknown: the run's own files do not say

offline_scopes.any config: no command acted: replay it to judge a model under any controller config
offline_scopes.any feedback gains: driven with no feedback acting: the feedback gains do not matter; the drive's own config (current loop, limits) does
offline_scopes.its own config: driven closed loop: judge a model by replaying it with the run's own config (config_sha256, kp / ki / kd); it says nothing about tracking under other gains
offline_scopes.split: a driven segment (its own config only), then a free one (any config)
offline_scopes.unknown: neither its excitation nor its loop is known
